target_customer: Vegan and plant-based shoppers in the US buying groceries online, with a Bay Area delivery start
problem: Vegan shoppers lacked a dedicated national store; the company ran an online vegan specialty store, pitched as Amazon for vegans, with a Mylk Unlimited subscription.
business_model: E-commerce vegan grocery store with a subscription program

founders.name: Gaurav Maken
prior_employers: Pioneer Fund (current title Community Partner on YC page)
founders.background_notes: From the YC page, listed as a former founder.

founders.name: Jinesh Shah
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; no bio.

exit.reason: Company notice says thin food margins and high shipping costs made the business financially unsustainable

competitors.name: Mylkman
competitors.what: Los Angeles service delivering freshly bottled almond milk and vegan foods

technical_complexity.rationale: An online store with subscriptions and third party fulfillment is standard e-commerce; the difficulty was logistics and margins, not software.

defensibility.rationale: Selling third party vegan products with exclusive launches had no stated lock-in, and general grocers and Amazon could stock the same items.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent acting on it; the company shut down citing margins and shipping.

market_need_then: Vegan products were a growing niche, but the company's own notice shows food margins and shipping costs left too little room; no 2018 demand data was found.

branding.domain_note: Used mylkguys.com; no purchase history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Warm and community focused; customers addressed as Mylk Fam and change-makers, with a planet-based life message

branding.brand_signature: Amazon for Vegans pitch and the Mylk Fam community address
branding.community_and_virality: Shutdown notice addresses a Mylk Fam community; no outside press about the brand found.

brand_strength.rationale: A distinctive spelling and a community tone, but press coverage and brand mentions were not found beyond a trademark record with the tagline Vegan is the new normal.

outcome_analysis: Mylk Guys joined YC in Summer 2018 with a vegan online store and raised a small amount, with a database reporting about 420 thousand dollars in total. The company's own closing notice says thin food margins and high shipping costs made the business unsustainable, a unit economics failure typical of grocery e-commerce. The shutdown date is not stated in the page seen; the notice only mentions pro-rated refunds from December 1.
notes: Both rounds rest on a single database (CB Insights), which reports about 420K total over three rounds; the third round and amounts were not visible. StartupIntros claims 2.5M from Khosla Ventures and Pear Ventures, which conflicts and is unverified so not recorded. Founding year taken from the 2018 batch and trademark filing, not a stated source. Shutdown notice was read on the company's own site; a search found the same notice via a mirror. Education not found. Mylkman source predates the batch by years and is only a rough analog.
